spec.name: Furniture Bone Wind Chime
spec.description: Ceiling-hung dark oak crossbar carrying three staggered cords, two clean ivory bone pendants and a small central skull. Twin suspension straps reach y=31.75. Connected, axis-aligned construction with no stand; front faces negative Z.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: ceiling-hung bone wind chime with dark crossbar, three thin cords at differing lengths, ivory bone pendants and small skull centerpiece; stylized clean bones, no floor stand. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Ceiling attachment: suspension points reach y=31.75, artwork hanging below. No ground support. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
